verdict.rationale: The pack documents an 'external access token' used for the Deployments API and symbol/source-map uploads, plus a source-map auth key. Neither is shown to be issuable per agent or limited to particular permissions, so they are adjacent credentials rather than scoped, least-privilege API keys. The official MCP server is documented, but nothing describes how its credentials are scoped.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
